# Synthetic financial-document test fixtures

These fixtures are synthetic and intended only for offline testing in the EasyMoney agent service.

- Every document in this directory is synthetic.
- The content exists only for software tests and evaluation scenarios.
- This corpus is not a real filing archive and must not be treated as a real SEC filing or an authoritative financial source.
- No copyrighted filing text was copied.
- No financial advice is provided.
- No private or secret information is included.
- The content is explicitly controlled for deterministic tests and path validation.
